recognize_zh: 中倍 H&E 骨髓切片中，骨小樑旁的骨髓腔被單一形態、成片的中型母細胞完全取代，核圓至卵圓、染色質細、可見小核仁，並散在有絲分裂像與凋亡細胞，缺乏正常造血與脂肪，符合 AML 浸潤。
features: Complete replacement of the marrow space by monotonous sheets of intermediate-sized blasts
Round to oval, occasionally indented nuclei with fine chromatin and small nucleoli
Moderate amphophilic cytoplasm with indistinct cell borders
Scattered mitotic figures and apoptotic bodies
Absence of adipocytes and normal trilineage hematopoiesis; bony trabecula at left
describe_en: H&E-stained bone marrow core biopsy shows a packed marrow adjacent to a bony trabecula, with complete replacement of fat and normal hematopoiesis by monotonous sheets of intermediate-sized blasts. The blasts have round to oval, occasionally indented nuclei with fine chromatin, small nucleoli and moderate amphophilic cytoplasm, with scattered mitoses and apoptotic bodies. Maturing erythroid, granulocytic and megakaryocytic elements are not evident in this field. Findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia in the setting of germline GATA2 mutation; lineage and genetic classification require immunophenotyping, cytogenetics and molecular studies.

ddx.vs: B-ALL blasts are TdT, CD19 and PAX5 positive and MPO negative, which requires IHC or flow to separate from AML.
Lymphoma cells are larger with vesicular chromatin and are CD20/PAX5 positive without myeloid marker expression.
Metastatic tumors form cohesive nests with desmoplasia and express keratin, synaptophysin or other non-hematopoietic markers while lacking CD45.
